note: When a program changes what a daily series counts, its values before and after are not comparable. Each entry names the day a new scope starts. COP's memory stamps every value with its scope and keeps them all; direction.py compares only the values of the newest scope. Since 24 Nov 2026 Watchfloor's feed states each zone's scope (measures.zone_scope; catalog 2026-11-24.1, ideas#241) and a change of it starts a new series by itself. Add an entry only for a series whose feed does not state its scope; zone_scope on an entry names the stated scope that continues it.
